texts.uz: Nightshift oʻzbek, rus va ingliz tillarida ishlaydi. Butun ilova shu uch tilda mavjud, kanal ssenariylari uchun esa ulardan istalganini tanlash mumkin. Ilova tilini istalgan payt almashtirishingiz mumkin.
texts.ru: Nightshift работает на узбекском, русском и английском. Всё приложение доступно на этих трёх языках, а языком сценариев канала можно выбрать любой из них. Язык приложения можно сменить в любой момент.
texts.en: Nightshift works in Uzbek, Russian and English. The whole app is available in all three, and you can pick any of them as the language of a channel's scripts. Switch the app language whenever you like.

evidence.claim: The app interface exists in exactly three locales: English, Russian and Uzbek.
The Home composer offers Uzbek, Russian and English as the script language.
A channel's saved language (its DNA) can be Uzbek, Russian or English.
The script is written in the channel's language (the run's language setting reaches the script prompt).
The language menu switches the whole interface between English, Russian and Uzbek.
The public Studio page states that the app is in Uzbek, Russian and English and that a channel is set to one of the three.
